decisions.reason: Although it draws loosely on the firm's biomass knowledge, a consumer superfood mix sits outside its strongest absorptive base in industrial process, plant and energy technology, and its long absence from the website points to resource reallocation.

This is technically close to the core, but two years without visible market presence suggest the standalone extension line is not yielding enough distinct commercial learning and is more likely to be folded into custom engineering work.

As a flagship waste-to-energy plant concept embedded in the firm's core conversion and engineering knowledge, it remains a product the firm can learn from and improve through its in-house R&D and research partnerships.

Despite being adjacent to the firm's capabilities, plastic-waste-to-fuel appears harder to commercialize and less evidently retained in the market, so management would likely shift effort toward core platforms with clearer absorptive fit and traction.
